# Reporting a bug

This project is a proof of concept and **is not supported**: a report may go unanswered, and
nothing will necessarily be fixed. You can still open an issue on the
[repository](https://github.com/owenb321/MiSTer_h264_decoder/issues) to record what you found --
it helps anyone who forks the project, and you are encouraged to fork it and fix it yourself.

A useful report includes:

- the **core version** from the OSD's About line (`<core name> <version> <yymmdd>`);
- the **program** that was feeding the core, and its version;
- what the stream was (resolution, frame rate, bitrate, the audio codec, if known);
- which output (HDMI or analog) and what you saw; a photo helps.

The issue forms ask for exactly these. Never attach copyrighted media.

A problem with MisterZine Plex goes to its own
[problem report](https://github.com/matijaerceg/misterzine-plex-core/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
instead, as its
[help page](https://github.com/matijaerceg/misterzine-plex-core/blob/main/release/README.md)
describes.
